content:
Grouping follows the **Link Distances** table (application × distance) and the **receiver** table (baud rate × sensitivity). The three orderable families (**LxS-ST11xx**, **ST11xx**, **Roughrider RR-ST11xx**) repeat the same optical applications with no per-model spec splits in the sheet. **1.0625 Gbps / 2.0625 Gbaud / -17 dBm** is not tied to any link-distance row, so it is not modeled here.
